WITH patient_wait AS (
    SELECT 
        c.clin_recip_registry AS patient_id,
        tm.org_spec AS organ,
        TRIM(SPLIT_PART(c.wait_time, ' ', 1))::int AS wait_days,
        ri.pra_score,
        CASE WHEN c.comorbid_detail IS NULL OR c.comorbid_detail = 'None' THEN 0
             ELSE LENGTH(c.comorbid_detail) - LENGTH(REPLACE(c.comorbid_detail, ',', '')) + 1
        END AS comorbidity_count,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tm.org_spec ORDER BY TRIM(SPLIT_PART(c.wait_time, ' ', 1))::int DESC) as rnk
    FROM transplant_matching tm
    JOIN clinical c ON tm.recip_ref_reg = c.clin_recip_registry
    JOIN recipients_immunology ri ON tm.recip_ref_reg = ri.immu_recip_registry
)
SELECT patient_id, organ, wait_days, pra_score, comorbidity_count
FROM patient_wait
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY organ, wait_days DESC
